# Dayloop v0.12.0-rc16

This candidate integrates the completed Metaphor: ReFantazio data audit into the Android app.

- Audits all 14 Followers and 112 ranks, including automatic, gated, travel-triggered, and manual progression.
- Replaces route-clear placeholders with real main-operation windows and adds timed-request / permanent-missable warnings.
- Repairs June–October route omissions across Royal Virtues, books, debates, Gold Beetles, requests, Followers, shopping, travel, Coliseum progression, dragon trials, and endgame branches.
- Corrects all 8 podium debates with route dates, winning answers, rewards, and availability schedules.
- Adds the canonical 44-achievement catalog with route events, counters, manual confirmations, conditional branches, and NG+ semantics.
- Corrects Help Anyone in Need to the supported 75/76 quest rule and keeps Closing the Book / Book of Apocalypse out of the first-playthrough calendar.
- Includes dedicated Metaphor regression coverage and closes the data audit through MET-AUD-025.
